Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> a '''mission''' was undertaken to the [[planet]] [[Skako Minor]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]]<ref name="Vader 28" /> [[Lieutenant Commander]]<ref name="Vader 25" /> [[Sabé]] to stop the nationalist leader [[Jul Tambor]], the grandson of former [[Techno Union]] [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]], from [[Uprising on Skako Minor|overthrowing]] the [[Skakoan Council|regime]] loyal to the Empire on the planet.<ref name="Vader 28" />
